subject: Application received
body: We received your application for the engineering position. Our hiring team will review your employment history.

subject: An update on your candidacy
body: Thank you for your interest in the software developer opening. We reviewed your submitted resume and have decided to move forward with other applicants.

subject: Interview invitation
body: Our recruiter would like your availability to schedule a meeting with the hiring manager. Join the interview through the calendar link.

subject: Meet the engineering team on Tuesday
body: We would like to discuss your experience as a candidate for the developer role. Please choose a time for your technical interview with our hiring team.

subject: Course assignment due Friday
body: Your history class essay is due Friday. Submit coursework through the university course portal. Contact your teacher if you need an extension.

subject: Registration for the new semester
body: Students can enroll in classes starting tomorrow. Review the academic calendar and meet your campus advisor to discuss your course schedule.

subject: Your monthly bank statement is ready
body: The statement for your checking account includes deposits, withdrawals and your current balance. Review recent banking transactions.

subject: Tax documents for your investments
body: Your annual investment income and tax reporting documents are available. Review dividend income and your brokerage account before filing taxes.

subject: Your receipt
body: Payment received. Amount paid: 24 dollars. Order number: SYNTHETIC-14. Thank you for your purchase.

subject: Your order is on its way
body: The headphones you purchased have shipped. Your order details and shipping tracking number are below. Keep this purchase confirmation for your records.

subject: Weekly digest
body: In this issue: technology headlines and this week's editorial roundup. Manage your subscription or unsubscribe from this newsletter.

subject: What happened in science this month
body: Welcome to our recurring editorial update for subscribers. Read this month's selected stories and articles. Manage preferences to stop receiving the mailing list.

subject: Dinner with the family on Sunday?
body: Hi, would you and the kids like to join us for dinner this weekend? We miss you. Let us know what time works for our family gathering.

subject: Happy birthday!
body: Hope you have a wonderful day, my friend. Let's celebrate together with a picnic. Love from all of us.

subject: Payment and account update
body: Your bank account statement and purchase receipt are available. Review your banking balance, paid invoice, purchase confirmation and order details.

subject: Hiring status and interview planning
body: We received your job application and resume for the developer position. Your application review is complete. Our recruiter will arrange interview scheduling and preparation with the hiring team.

subject: Service outage alert
body: A production database cluster is unavailable. Restart the internal service and investigate the failed deployment. Incident operators should check server health.
